snippet.title: RACE AND CHASE - BlueBirdRP Content Drop October 2023
snippet.description:
The Race and Chase Content Drop for BlueBirdRP
This update was released on 24/09/2023 as an early update for October.
It includes the following:
 - Updated vehicle handling for:
     - Annis Euros
     - Annis Remus
     - Annis ZR350
     - Dinka Jester RR
     - Dinka RT3000
     - Emperor Vectre
     - Karin Futo GTX
     - Karin Previon
     - Karin Sultan RS Classic
     - Obey Tailgater S
     - Pfister Comet S2
     - Pfister Growler
     - Übermacht Cypher
     - Vapid Dominator ASP
     - Vapid Dominator GTT
     - Vulcar Warrener HKR
 - Race phones are craftable with the right components
 - Race barriers are craftable with the right components
 - Jump barriers have been removed to allow for more jumps to be taken
 - More realistic damage script introduced to damage vehicle tyres when taken off jumps that are "too high"
 - Dodgy Dennis has been run out of business by a new competitor in the market who is willing to pay more but the jobs will be harder
 - New Dodge Charger added to make all of your friend jealous

For everything BlueBirdRP visit:
 https://bluebirdrp.live/

Development work done by:
- Car handling edits [MrDarkWolfz]
- Race phone [NullVariable]
- Race barrier [NullVariable]
- Dodgy Dennis updates [ScarAus]
- Remvoing barriers for jumps [TheMightSmith]

Video edit by MeiBei
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCWdYqB1hLXOkM5j0B2VKwEQ
